xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ncbi_application xmlns="ncbi:application"
 xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
 xs:schemaLocation="ncbi:application ncbi_application.xsd"
>
<program type="regular">
<name>windowmasker</name>
<version>0.2.0</version>
<description>Window based sequence masker</description>
<detailed_description></detailed_description>
</program>
<arguments>
<key name="checkdup" type="Boolean" optional="true">
<description>check for duplicate sequences</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>check_duplicates</synopsis>
<default>false</default>
</key>
<key name="dust" type="Boolean" optional="true">
<description>combine window masking with dusting</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>use_dust</synopsis>
<default>F</default>
</key>
<key name="dust_level" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>dust minimum level</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>dust_level</synopsis>
<default>20</default>
</key>
<key name="exclude_ids" type="String" optional="true">
<description>file containing the list of ids to exclude from processing</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>exclude_id_list</synopsis>
<default></default>
</key>
<key name="fa_list" type="Boolean" optional="true">
<description>indicates that -input represents a file containing a list of names of fasta files to process, one name  per line</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>input_is_a_list</synopsis>
<default>false</default>
</key>
<key name="genome_size" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>total size of the genome</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>genome_size</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="ids" type="String" optional="true">
<description>file containing the list of ids to process</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>id_list</synopsis>
<default></default>
</key>
<key name="in" type="File_In" optional="true">
<description>input file name (not optional if used with -mk_counts or -convert options)</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>input_file_name</synopsis>
<default>-</default>
</key>
<key name="infmt" type="String" optional="true">
<description>controls the format of the masker input</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>input_format</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>`blastdb', `fasta', `seqids'</description>
<Strings case_sensitive="true">
<value>blastdb</value>
<value>fasta</value>
<value>seqids</value>
</Strings>
</constraint>
<default>fasta</default>
</key>
<key name="mem" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>memory available for mk_counts option in megabytes</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>available_memory</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 1</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
<default>1536</default>
</key>
<key name="meta" type="String" optional="true">
<description>add metadata to the counts file</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>info_string</synopsis>
<default></default>
</key>
<key name="out" type="File_Out" optional="true">
<description>output file name</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>output_file_name</synopsis>
<default>-</default>
</key>
<key name="outfmt" type="String" optional="true">
<description>controls the format of the masker output (for masking stage only)</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>output_format</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>`fasta', `interval', `maskinfo_asn1_bin', `maskinfo_asn1_text', `maskinfo_xml', `seqloc_asn1_bin', `seqloc_asn1_text', `seqloc_xml'</description>
<Strings case_sensitive="true">
<value>fasta</value>
<value>interval</value>
<value>maskinfo_asn1_bin</value>
<value>maskinfo_asn1_text</value>
<value>maskinfo_xml</value>
<value>seqloc_asn1_bin</value>
<value>seqloc_asn1_text</value>
<value>seqloc_xml</value>
</Strings>
</constraint>
<default>interval</default>
</key>
<key name="set_t_high" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>alternative high score for a unit if theoriginal unit score is more than highscore</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>score_value</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 1</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="set_t_low" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>alternative low score for a unit if theoriginal unit score is lower than lowscore</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>score_value</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 1</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="sformat" type="String" optional="true">
<description>controls the format of the output file containing the unit counts (for counts generation and conversion only)</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>unit_counts_format</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>`ascii', `binary', `oascii', `obinary'</description>
<Strings case_sensitive="true">
<value>ascii</value>
<value>binary</value>
<value>oascii</value>
<value>obinary</value>
</Strings>
</constraint>
<default>ascii</default>
</key>
<key name="smem" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>target size of the output file containing the unit counts</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>available_memory</synopsis>
<default>512</default>
</key>
<key name="t_extend" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>window score above which it is allowed to extend masking</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_extend</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 0</description>
<Integers>
<min>0</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="t_extend_pct" type="Real" optional="true">
<description>window score above which it is allowed to extend masking as percentage</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_extend_pct</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>0..100</description>
<Doubles>
<min>0</min>
<max>100</max>
</Doubles>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="t_high" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>maximum useful unit score</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_high</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 1</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="t_high_pct" type="Real" optional="true">
<description>maximum useful unit score as percentage</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_high_pct</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>0..100</description>
<Doubles>
<min>0</min>
<max>100</max>
</Doubles>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="t_low" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>minimum useful unit score</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_low</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 1</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="t_low_pct" type="Real" optional="true">
<description>minimum useful unit score as percentage</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_low_pct</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>0..100</description>
<Doubles>
<min>0</min>
<max>100</max>
</Doubles>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="t_thres" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>window score threshold used to trigger masking</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_threshold</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 1</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="t_thres_pct" type="Real" optional="true">
<description>window score threshold used to trigger masking as percentage</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>T_threshold_pct</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>0..100</description>
<Doubles>
<min>0</min>
<max>100</max>
</Doubles>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="text_match" type="Boolean" optional="true">
<description>match ids as strings</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>text_match_ids</synopsis>
<default>T</default>
</key>
<key name="unit" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>number of bases in a unit</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>unit_length</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>1..16</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>16</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="ustat" type="String" optional="true">
<description>file with unit counts</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>unit_counts</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="window" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>window size</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>window_size</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>greater or equal to 1</description>
<Integers>
<min>1</min>
<max>2147483647</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
</key>
<flag name="convert" optional="true">
<description>convert counts between different formats</description>
<group>1</group>
</flag>
<flag name="h" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE and DESCRIPTION;  ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
<flag name="help" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS; ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
<flag name="mk_counts" optional="true">
<description>generate frequency counts for a database</description>
<group>1</group>
</flag>
<flag name="parse_seqids" optional="true">
<description>Parse Seq-ids in FASTA input</description>
<group>1</group>
</flag>
<flag name="version-full" optional="true">
<description>Print extended version data;  ignore other arguments</description>
</flag>
<flag name="version-full-json" optional="true">
<description>Print extended version data in JSON format;  ignore other arguments</description>
</flag>
<flag name="version-full-xml" optional="true">
<description>Print extended version data in XML format;  ignore other arguments</description>
</flag>
<flag name="xmlhelp" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS in XML format; ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
